title: Rust documentation task (executed): README documents the wrong behaviour of sum

task.statement: The fixture crate fixture-docs-sum in this workspace implements sum(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 correctly in src/lib.rs, but README.md documents the wrong behaviour (it claims sum returns a - b and that sum(2, 2) == 0). Fix ONLY the README so it documents the implementation truthfully: sum returns a + b and sum(2, 2) == 4. Do not alter the source, the tests or any other file.

expected.observableOutcome: the disposable source repository is staged and content-verified, an isolated writable git worktree is acquired under the pinned authority, the fixture-scripted documentation repair (README.md only) is applied with permission, the real doc-content validator (cargo test --offline --test docs) runs and exits 0, and the post-run tree digest reflects the repaired README; the envelope binds route/attempt/journal/accounting/workspace records

validation.expectedAssertion: pinned-fixture-task: README.md documents sum(a, b) as a + b and `sum(2, 2) == 4` (and no longer claims a - b or `sum(2, 2) == 0`); verified by `cargo test --offline --test docs` in the isolated workspace
